data: The course essentially is a hands-on introduction to various types of neural networks used in  machine learning and decision trees. Topics include Decision Trees, Bagging Random Forests and Boosting,  Introduction to Basic Neural Networks, Activation Functions, Deep Neural Networks (Convolutional Neural  Networks (CNN), Recurrent Neural Networks (LSTM), Autoencoders, Generative Adversarial Networks  (GAN), and transformer architectures with applications to problems in Image Processing and Computer  Vision. This course will also introduce Python tools and libraries including scikit-learn, Keras, TensorFlow,  and PyTorch.
